name: Shizuku
source:
Her calm, mature demeanor contrasts with her youthful appearance, and thus her age is a mystery. Chris meets her on a stroll at night and brings her back to the mansion. She lacks linguistic skills, and at first not much about her is learned. Because Shizuku is unable to take care of herself, Chris offers to pay her rent as well.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Popotan_characters#Shizuku]Wikipedia[/url].]
